technical-summary: RUM04 steps (i) and (ii-core): every serving config is one native YAML with a closed x-bigcherry section; the engine inspector returns that section and the tuning values from the same sealed bytes, bc-serve decodes them against the closed v1 schema, and the resolver reads a config from its YAML through a device-free inspect. explain --native-config passes all 18 configs and the resolved values equal the TOML-era reference with no TOML present. rad0009 takes the admitted rank-devices when the YAML omits them. Commits f597a0a39..d214bf5a8 on node/radiance-latest-bump.
user-summary-candidate: Radiance serving configs are now single native YAML files; a start no longer reads the old TOML catalogue to resolve them.
